# Animal models

These animated 3D models are used under the [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
licence (CC BY 4.0), downloaded from Sketchfab on 15 November 2026. The files are unchanged; the animal builder
(`Assets/Editor/AnimalPrefabBuilder.cs`) scales them to real body sizes, picks their idle, walk, run, eat and flight
clips, leaves out the cat model's display stand (`Object_54`), turns the cat to face forward and tints the pigeon's
white texture to a city pigeon's blue-grey.

| Animal in Coupled Sim | Model | Author | File |
|---|---|---|---|
| Dog | ["PitBull"](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/pitbull-2be37d5b9f754ed4bcc2d8f41b23a1d7) | [Joseph.AD](https://sketchfab.com/Joseph.AD) | `PitBull.glb` |
| Cat | ["Somali Cat Animated ver 1.2"](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/somali-cat-animated-ver-12-e185c3fd92b64c32b4515a32b29252fc) | [DreamNoms](https://sketchfab.com/DreamNoms) | `SomaliCat.glb` |
| Pigeon | ["Animated Bird, Pigeon"](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/animated-bird-pigeon-797d27b68af3453e865149435df6aa30) | [dudecon](https://sketchfab.com/dudecon) | `Pigeon.glb` |
| Deer | ["Realistic Animated Doe 3D Model"](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/realistic-animated-doe-3d-model-b6172618aa304473a4cf7b9246c0a218) | [WildMesh 3D](https://sketchfab.com/WildMesh_3D) | `Doe.glb` |
| Horse | ["Horse"](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/horse-a6f860e43e364619bccb174a1ac7d0c9) | [henrysteve973](https://sketchfab.com/henrysteve973) | `Horse.glb` |

The husky and the fox are the CC0 models by Quaternius in `Assets/ThirdParty/Quaternius/Animals` (no realistic animated
husky or fox is free).
